verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 4.8/10). The series of 24 commits ending at 34cee4b successfully resolved 38 distinct findings from round 47 across gimbal video, camera settings, raw parameter editing, flight plan tools/dialogs/rounding, flight data actions, radio calibration, and accelerometer calibration. Test suite expanded to 255 passed tests with 0 failures. However, under the strict hostile adversarial audit standard, any open P1 finding caps the overall score at <= 5.0. Five critical P1 gaps remain open: DroneCAN auxiliary tools (R47-18) are unported stubs; MainV2 post-connect tasks (R47-19: param cache, Params_BG, NewFirmware, CheckBatteryShow, RALLY_TOTAL) are missing; desktop-only rfd file pickers (R47-20) remain unported to platform::FilePicker across 15+ call sites; mobile serial/BLE/WinUSB transports and TTS speech backends (R47-21) are unimplemented; and mobile native packaging/device execution receipts (R47-22) remain absent. Additionally, Flight Data force-arm still processes the Enter hotkey and lacks the un-acked arm timeout path (R47-05).

scores.scale: 0 to 10 against an exact Mission Planner clone on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS. A partial match gets no credit. With any P0 or P1 open, the cap is 5.0.

findings.subsystem: Initial Setup / DroneCAN: Inspector, Filter and Stats buttons (R47-18 still open)
evidence: C# ConfigDroneCAN.cs:714-722 But_uavcaninspector_Click opens DroneCANInspector form; but_filter_Click (897+) applies the default message filter list; but_stats_Click (1392+) opens CanStats DataGridView window fed by dronecan_protocol_CanStats.

Rust crates/mp-app/src/views/dronecan_page.rs:101-102 sends 'but_stats' to app.toasts.info (logger only, no visible UI); 'but_uavcaninspector' and 'but_filter' log 'Node and message details are shown below the node list.' No window or filter table is opened.
findings.impact: DroneCAN diagnostic inspector, filter configuration, and bus traffic statistics tools are inoperable.
findings.required_fix: Port DroneCANInspector form, filter list management, and the bus statistics DataGridView window.

findings.subsystem: MainV2: doConnect post-connect steps (R47-19 still open)
evidence: C# MainV2.cs:1664-1696 loads parameter cache (UseCachedParams, ParamCachePath younger than 1 h) or, when Params_BG is set, runs getParamListMavftp in the background. It then checks for newer firmware with Common.MessageShowAgain(Strings.NewFirmware ...). It saves '<port>_BAUD', runs FlightData.CheckBatteryShow, and fetches rally points when RALLY_TOTAL > 0 (1769-1780).
In crates/mp-app/src, no occurrences of ParamCachePath, NewFirmware, CheckBatteryShow, or RALLY_TOTAL exist. Params_BG setting is never evaluated.
findings.impact: Autopilot connect sequence skips parameter cache acceleration, background MAVFtp param sync, firmware update notification, rally point download, and battery voltage check dialog.
findings.required_fix: Port the full post-connect tail in MainV2/link connection handler.

findings.subsystem: Cross-platform: file dialogs used by user-facing tools (R47-20 still open)
evidence: crates/mp-app/Cargo.toml restricts `rfd` to non-mobile targets. Over 15 direct `rfd::FileDialog` invocations remain across firmware_ui.rs:452, georef_ui.rs:64/70, joystick.rs:440/452, more_tools.rs:121/139/306, tool_windows.rs:22/32, config.rs:2276, device_pages.rs:119, fd_tabs.rs:223, flight_data.rs:564/2207, flight_plan.rs:781, mavftp.rs:155/268, setup_pages.rs:37/45, and survey_ui.rs:747.
On Android and iOS, `rfd::FileDialog` calls are compiled out or unavailable, causing file open/save actions to fail silently.
findings.impact: Key user-facing file workflows (log loading, script loading, HUD recording, custom firmware, joystick configs, KML/Shape injection) are unusable on mobile platforms.
findings.required_fix: Refactor all user-facing file dialog call sites to use `platform::FilePicker`, which includes mobile file provider integration.

findings.subsystem: Cross-platform: transports and speech (R47-21 still open)
evidence: crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs:126 and 132 return Err('... transport is not yet supported') for CommsEndpoint::Ble and CommsEndpoint::WinUsb. comms.rs:162-168 returns 'serial ports are not available on this platform' on Android and iOS.
crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs:26-48 speak_blocking implements Windows SAPI, macOS say, and Linux speech-dispatcher/espeak branches only. Android and iOS speech synthesis are completely absent.
findings.impact: Bluetooth Low Energy and USB-serial connectivity on mobile/tablet platforms fail. Voice telemetry announcements are silent on Android and iOS.
findings.required_fix: Implement mobile serial drivers (Android USB Host / UsbSerial), CoreBluetooth / Android BLE GATT transports, and Android TextToSpeech / iOS AVSpeechSynthesizer TTS bridges.

findings.subsystem: Native delivery: iOS and Android packaging (R47-22 still open)
evidence: The project has no automated build receipt, signed packaging artifact, or device execution receipt for iOS (.ipa / TestFlight) or Android (.apk / .aab). Audits remain confined to host-platform execution on Windows.
findings.impact: Cross-platform delivery claim remains unverified on target mobile hardware.
findings.required_fix: Provide automated packaging scripts and verifiable run logs / screenshots from physical or simulator iOS and Android runs.

findings.subsystem: Flight Data: BUT_ARM_Click Enter shortcut and arm timeout path (R47-05 remainder)
evidence: C# FlightData.cs:1070-1075: doARM() returning false without an ACK (e.g. timeout after 8000ms) opens the Force Arm prompt. The CustomMessageBox shown with custom buttons ('Force Arm', 'Cancel') does not default Enter to Force Arm.

Rust flight_data.rs:1741 has an unconditional `else if ctx.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::Enter)) { result = Some(true); }`, allowing accidental keyboard trigger of Force Arm. Furthermore, arming failure only triggers on negative CommandAck (flight_data.rs:335), not on timeout.
findings.impact: If arm command packets are dropped, the force-arm dialog never appears. Users pressing Enter in error can accidentally force-arm.
findings.required_fix: Disable Enter shortcut on Confirmed::ForceArm prompt, and add an 8-second timeout fallback that opens the force-arm prompt when no ACK arrives.

findings.subsystem: Flight Plan: saveWPs Terrain.checkTerrain loop (R47-06 remainder)
evidence: C# FlightPlanner.cs:6330-6345 iterates through all located waypoints in the mission and runs `Terrain.checkTerrain(loc.lat, loc.lng)` to pre-cache elevation data, reporting 'Done.' only after terrain checking completes.
Rust flight_plan.rs:583-605 handles parameter writes and home query in post_upload, but omits the Terrain.checkTerrain prefetch loop.
findings.impact: Terrain data for planned waypoints is not pre-cached to disk upon upload.
findings.required_fix: Add background terrain tile check/download loop following mission upload completion.
